name: AI in Manufacturing and Industrial Operations: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free hour built around real plant jobs: a maintenance planner turning overnight vibration alerts into work orders, a technician diagnosing a drive fault with a manual-citing copilot without touching lockout/tagout, a quality engineer setting the threshold on an AI terminal-lock vision check, an OT engineer deciding read-only versus write-back for a vendor's cloud link, a machine-safety engineer classifying ML person detection, and a pharma QA specialist drafting a deviation summary under human review.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Manufacturing and Industrial Operations

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI in Manufacturing and Industrial Operations: The One-Hour Briefing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 8 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
